description: Create a HubSpot record: contacts (email required), companies (name required), deals (dealname + dealstage required — stage ids from list_hubspot_pipelines), tasks (hs_task_subject required). `properties` take INTERNAL names. Optional associations {contact_id, company_id, deal_id} link the new record. Checks for a DUPLICATE first (contact by e-mail, company by name/domain, deal by name) and returns it as a question — set allow_duplicate only after a human confirmed. WRITES into the customer's CRM — permission gate + write log; dry run when the connection's write_mode is "dry_run" or dry_run is set.

allow_duplicate.description: Create even if a matching entry already exists

associations.description: Records to link the new one to: { contact_id, company_id, deal_id }

dry_run.description: Only simulate and report what would happen; change nothing

properties.description: Property values to set (property name → value)

name: create_hubspot_record
